name: Natsuki Hoshino
want: make Class 1-B the closest class in the school
secret: Her father is being transferred to Sapporo in two years and the whole family will move; she has told no one and smiles harder because of it.
voice: Bright, warm, lots of exclamation marks; remembers everyone's name.
description: Talks to everyone, organises everything, cries at films.
appearance: Short brown hair with a sunflower clip, a smile that reaches her eyes, cardigan sleeves over her hands.

agenda.goal: throw a welcome party for Class 1-B
steps: starts a class group chat and adds everyone

steps.text: asks the player to help plan a class karaoke party by the station

steps: books the karaoke room and badgers the whole class into coming
